comment: A pick on Fillet's preview names the edge before the fillet it comes from (mitcad#1458, GitHub mitcad/Mitcad#177), tools/ui-fillet-preview-pick-test.sh: a plate 60 x 50 x 5 (F1.b0, its top F1:top at z 5) and on it a block 20 x 10 x 15 joined (F2) from the origin, its front F2:side0 at y 0, its ends F2:side1 at x 20 and F2:side3 at x 0; Fillet1 (F3) rounds the ends' foot edges with 4 mm. The front's foot edge runs between the roundings' ends.
